scripts.vercel:deploy:
vercel deploy --prebuilt --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN --meta githubCommitAuthorName=${GITHUB_COMMIT_AUTHOR_NAME} --meta githubCommitOrg=${GITHUB_COMMIT_ORG} --meta githubCommitRef=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REF} --meta githubCommitSha=${GITHUB_COMMIT_SHA} --meta githubDeployment=${GITHUB_DEPLOYMENT} --meta githubOrg=${GITHUB_ORG} --meta githubRepo=${GITHUB_REPO} --meta githubCommitRepo=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REPO} | grep -o 'https://[^ ]*' | head -n 1 | xargs -I {} echo '### Imagine One
- [Preview URL]({})
' >> ../../preview_comment.md
scripts.vercel:deploy:staging: vercel deploy --target=staging --prebuilt --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN --meta githubCommitAuthorName=${GITHUB_COMMIT_AUTHOR_NAME} --meta githubCommitOrg=${GITHUB_COMMIT_ORG} --meta githubCommitRef=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REF} --meta githubCommitSha=${GITHUB_COMMIT_SHA} --meta githubDeployment=${GITHUB_DEPLOYMENT} --meta githubOrg=${GITHUB_ORG} --meta githubRepo=${GITHUB_REPO} --meta githubCommitRepo=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REPO}
scripts.vercel:deploy:prod: vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN --meta githubCommitAuthorName=${GITHUB_COMMIT_AUTHOR_NAME} --meta githubCommitOrg=${GITHUB_COMMIT_ORG} --meta githubCommitRef=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REF} --meta githubCommitSha=${GITHUB_COMMIT_SHA} --meta githubDeployment=${GITHUB_DEPLOYMENT} --meta githubOrg=${GITHUB_ORG} --meta githubRepo=${GITHUB_REPO} --meta githubCommitRepo=${GITHUB_COMMIT_REPO}
